checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan Frontier Shipyard services: a local shipyard outpost satisfies hull, fuel, escort, weapon and refit service checks, with SERVICES ONLINE and SHIPYARD LINK visibility.

impact_assessment.why: The Frontier Shipyard outpost advertised construction and hull servicing but only produced credits; every service still required a station or colony dock.
impact_assessment.benefits: Shipyard outposts fulfill their catalog role, extend fleet operating range, and make remote frontier bases strategically useful.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: station-only depot cargo must stay separate and error text must keep fuel/repair context; dependency: many service methods share the new check; concurrency: service calls mutate credits and ship/outpost state under the engine lock; state: remote shipyards must not service the current system and combat must still block services.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add local, remote and no-shipyard regressions first; keep depot operations station-only; verify undocked repair/refuel and both UI markers in live Edge.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Local shipyard service check across hull, fuel, reactor, mods, weapons, escorts, training, upgrades, chassis, mercenaries and refits; station-only depots preserved; SERVICES ONLINE and SHIPYARD LINK UI implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-101 recorded; live Edge repaired an undocked hull 50->60 and fuel 10->20, with SERVICES ONLINE and SHIPYARD LINK; 883 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'shipyard-services' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan level-3 outpost specializations: Industry/Research/Commerce/Logistics production focuses, a fourth crew slot for Logistics, 600 cr switching, and a select/SET control on the outpost card.

impact_assessment.why: Outposts gained modules and crew but leveling past 2 only raised a flat multiplier, so there was no level-3 decision that changed what an installation was for.
impact_assessment.benefits: Reaching level 3 unlocks a real economic identity, Logistics deepens the crew loop, and switching lets players adapt to changing needs.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: specialization must default empty for legacy saves and production must share one multiplier across tick, cash flow and reports; dependency: crew capacity now depends on the focus; concurrency: specialization mutates credits, outpost state and the flight log under the engine lock; state: switching must be refused when credits are short and production must stay stable after reload.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add production, level-gate, cost, capacity, persistence and API/CLI/UI regressions first; validate the focus id; verify the live Empire SET control.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Persisted Outpost.specialization, four level-3 focus multipliers, Logistics crew slot, 600 cr switching, production/report payload fields, /api/outpost/specialize, outpost specialize CLI and Empire select/SET control implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-102 recorded; live Edge set a level-3 outpost to Industry for 600 cr; 893 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'outpost-specialization' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan per-escort service records: battles, kills, patrol bounties/contacts and training sessions, with payload, CLI and fleet-card visibility.

impact_assessment.why: Escorts tracked rank, XP and role but forgot their history; battles, kills, patrol bounties and training were only transient log lines.
impact_assessment.benefits: Veteran hulls gain a visible history, patrol/training activity becomes legible, and players can compare escorts beyond raw damage.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: legacy ships must default all counters to zero and payload serialization must stay backward compatible; dependency: combat, patrol and training paths all increment counters; concurrency: counters mutate inside the same fleet replaces as XP and hull; state: counters must persist and never go negative.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add legacy-default, persistence, training, patrol-contact and combat-victory regressions first; clamp on load; verify the live service line.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Persisted battles/kills/patrol credits/patrol contacts/training sessions, incremented them on victories, patrol contacts and training, and surfaced SVC counters in the fleet card and CLI with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-103 recorded; live Edge showed SVC 3B / 2K / 1P / 77CR; 899 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'fleet-service-records' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan outpost integrity and defense: conquest damage, Sentry Grid/marine defense, integrity-scaled production, and a credit repair contract with UI/CLI/API.

impact_assessment.why: Outpost integrity only regenerated upward and nothing could damage it, so defense had no meaning and conquest never threatened frontier industry.
impact_assessment.benefits: War threatens frontier production, defense modules and marine crews gain a concrete use, and damaged outposts can be restored for credits.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing outposts must keep full production at 100 integrity and Sentry Grids must not inflate the module multiplier; dependency: capture detection runs after faction simulation and uses crew defense; concurrency: damage and repair mutate outpost state, credits and the flight log under the engine lock; state: integrity must persist, scale production, and never go negative.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add defense, production-scaling, capture-damage, repair and API/CLI/UI regressions first; clamp integrity; verify the live repair control.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Sentry Grid module, defense math, capture damage on hostile system changes, integrity-scaled production, repair_outpost, /api/outpost/repair, outpost repair CLI and INT/DEF/REPAIR UI implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-104 recorded; live Edge showed INT 41%/DEF 22 and repaired to 100% for 475 cr; 909 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'outpost-defense' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan war bonds: settle pledges once when a war ends, paying 1.5x on victory, 0.8x on stalemate and nothing on defeat, with UI terms and tick telemetry.

impact_assessment.why: War support let players pledge credits for standing and front momentum, but the pledge was a pure sink with no reason to care whether the backed side won.
impact_assessment.benefits: War pledges become a risk/reward investment, stalemates soften losses, and the war card explains the terms before committing.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing wars must default to unresolved bonds and payouts must never repeat across saves; dependency: settlement runs after faction simulation and before credits are cloned; concurrency: payouts mutate wars, credits, stats and the flight log under the engine lock; state: bonds_resolved must persist and loser pledges must pay zero.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add active/winner/defender/stalemate/double-pay and persistence regressions first; clamp pledges; verify the live war-card terms.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Persisted bonds_resolved, one-time settlement helper, victory/defeat/stalemate payouts, credits/stats/payload integration, support_war terms and Factions war-card bond note implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-105 recorded; live Edge showed bond terms and a 500 cr pledge; 918 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'war-bonds' completed successfully.
